newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - Dollar content with range, Tokyo holidays.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dollar content with range, Tokyo holidays.

text.p: *Dollar dead in line with Friday's NY finish and not expected to wander far near term with Japan on holiday
*Analysts cautious on outlook following last week's retreat from rally highs and looking to sell rallies for now
*Medium term still bullish on the familiar story of diverging economic trends and interest rates
*Sterling extends rally on dollar and mark due UK rate talk
Analysts were also donwbeat on dollar/mark despite its bounce from 1.7195 late Friday, noting a trio of lower tops since it peaked around 1.7390 this time last week.

While US$0.7335 capped, they looked for a drift to 1.7240 enroute to 1.7200 but again few were seriously bearish on the currency and saw any weakness as a minor correction in a long term uptrend to 1.7800 and beyond.

Sterling extended its rally as the market anticipated a rise in U.K. rates as soon as Wednesday when the new Chancellor meets the Bank of England governor. It was up at 1.6235/45 and 2.8070/80 marks from 1.6170/80 and 2.7940/50 late in London.
